_meta.description: Published benchmark scores for OCR/Document AI systems. Use these for comparison against our engine_compare results.

DocVQA.task: Document Visual Question Answering on scanned business docs
DocVQA.notes: DocVQA is a VQA benchmark — raw OCR engines score N/A without a QA layer.

OCRBench.task: Comprehensive OCR evaluation (text recognition, formula, table, handwriting)
OCRBench.notes: OCRBench tests pure text recognition accuracy on diverse doc types. Scores for Marker/Docling not in original paper.

FUNSD.task: Form understanding — entity extraction + linking in noisy scanned forms
FUNSD.notes: FUNSD tests structure understanding beyond raw OCR. DocumentAgent's block extraction is most analogous here.

TableBench.notes: TEDS measures how well the table structure (rows, columns, spans) is recovered.

CER_WER_reference.task: Character Error Rate / Word Error Rate on born-digital PDFs (native text layer as GT)
CER_WER_reference.caveat: CER/WER vs native text layer measures OCR character fidelity but NOT structure, ordering, or understanding. DocumentAgent optimizes for structured output, not raw character fidelity.
